title.en: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API pricing and its first High AI Self-Improvement external rating
title.zhHans: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，下调 API 定价并首次对外发布达到 AI 自我改进 High 阈值的模型

searchSummary.en: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra ($8/$40 per 1M tokens, 20% below GPT-6 Astra) and GPT-6.2 Sol; its System Card rates both Critical in Cybersecurity, High in Bio/Chem, and Astra as OpenAI's first externally released model rated High in AI Self-Improvement.
searchSummary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 17 日，OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra（API 输入/输出单价较 GPT-6 Astra 降 20% 至 8/40 美元每百万 token）与 GPT-6.2 Sol；系统卡将二者网络安全能力列为 Critical、生化列为 High，并将 Astra 标定为 OpenAI 首个对外发布且达到 AI 自我改进 High 阈值的模型。

summary.en: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API. OpenAI cut GPT-6.2 Astra API token pricing by 20% compared with GPT-6 Astra ($8 input, $0.40 cached input, $40 output per million tokens) while keeping GPT-6.1 Sol pricing for GPT-6.2 Sol. In its accompanying System Card, OpenAI stated that both models meet the Critical threshold for Cybersecurity and High threshold for Biological and Chemical capabilities under its Preparedness Framework, and that GPT-6.2 Astra is its first externally released model to meet the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 17 日，OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 及 API 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 GPT-6.2 Sol。GPT-6.2 Astra 的 API 输入与输出价格较 GPT-6 Astra 下调 20%（每百万 token 输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.40 美元、输出 40 美元），GPT-6.2 Sol 维持 GPT-6.1 Sol 价格。随附系统卡披露，两款模型在 OpenAI 准备度框架下均达到网络安全 Critical 阈值与生化能力 High 阈值，且 GPT-6.2 Astra 是 OpenAI 首个对外发布并达到 AI 自我改进 High 阈值的模型。

narrative.en: GPT-6.2 continues OpenAI's push on lower token costs and multistep professional workflows alongside tighter cybersecurity safeguards that OpenAI acknowledged restrict some legitimate vulnerability research. Independent roundup coverage by Latent Space highlighted lower per-task benchmark costs alongside mixed early developer reviews of Astra's practical behavior; vendor benchmark scores remain distinct from independently verified production adoption.
narrative.zhHans: GPT-6.2 延续了 OpenAI 压低单位任务成本与强化多步骤专业工作流的路线，同时因网络安全能力跃升而收紧了高风险网络防护（OpenAI 坦言这会限制部分合规漏洞研究工作流）。独立技术综述 Latent Space 指出，两款模型降低了基准任务成本，但早期测试者对 Astra 的实际使用体验评价不一；厂商自测跑分仍须与独立生产采用加以区分。

text.en: On November 17, 2026, OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the OpenAI API.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 11 月 17 日，OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work、Codex 与 OpenAI API 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol。

text.en: OpenAI lowered GPT-6.2 Astra API token prices by 20% versus GPT-6 Astra to $8 input, $0.40 cached input, and $40 output per million tokens.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 将 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 API token 单价较 GPT-6 Astra 下调 20%，降至每百万 token 输入 8 美元、缓存输入 0.40 美元、输出 40 美元。

text.en: In its November 17, 2026 System Card, OpenAI classified both GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol at the Critical threshold for Cybersecurity and High for Biological and Chemical capabilities, and classified GPT-6.2 Astra at the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement.
text.zhHans: 在 2026 年 11 月 17 日发布的系统卡中，OpenAI 将 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 均定级为网络安全 Critical 阈值、生化能力 High 阈值，并将 GPT-6.2 Astra 定级为 AI 自我改进 High 阈值。

text.en: Independent roundup reporting noted mixed early tester feedback on working with GPT-6.2 Astra despite lower benchmark costs, and OpenAI stated its headline cyber benchmarks used internal configurations with cybersecurity safeguards and classifiers disabled.
text.zhHans: 独立综述报道指出，尽管基准成本下降，早期测试者对 GPT-6.2 Astra 的实际体验存在分歧；此外 OpenAI 明确说明其网络安全跑分采用关闭网络安全防护与分类器的内部测试配置。

description.en: 20% API price reduction and 60% cached-input discount on GPT-6.2 Astra lower direct developer token cost compared with GPT-6 Astra.
description.zhHans: GPT-6.2 Astra API 降价 20% 且缓存输入折让 60%，直接降低了开发者的前沿模型调用单价。

description.en: First externally released OpenAI model rated High for AI Self-Improvement alongside Critical Cybersecurity and High Bio/Chem Preparedness ratings.
description.zhHans: 系统卡将网络安全列为 Critical、生化列为 High，并首次对外发布达到 AI 自我改进 High 阈值的模型。
